note: Root cause: MuddCompose.w1/w2/bias (real weight matrices, not true scalars) were in the SCALAR_LR=0.20 AdamW group (8x more aggressive than MATRIX_LR=0.025) -- an implementation/hyperparameter bug, not a fundamental flaw in the MUDD mechanism. Consistent with the paper's own depth-scaling framing: MUDD's demonstrated benefit is at LM depths >=24 layers (up to 42); this repo's locked DEPTH=6 is well below anything the paper tests. Not kept, default OFF.
